synopsis: 拉札洛是一位單純善良的年輕農民，在與世隔絕的義大利小城內生活著，他和驕縱叛逆的莊園少爺坦奎迪，從雇傭關係意外結為好友。某天，坦奎迪自導自演了一齣無聊的綁架鬧劇，沒料到卻在這鬧劇中衍生出另一場意外，讓拉札洛穿越時空到多年以後，在人事已非的狀況下，他要如何面對這毫無所知的新世界呢？ 義大利名導艾莉絲羅爾瓦雀魔幻寫實力作，榮獲坎城影展最佳劇本獎。以純樸的義大利鄉村做為背景的寓言故事，透過魔幻寫實手法，淬煉出純真與黑暗、善良與貪婪，將現代都市化的悲歌，昇華成無法言喻而發人深省的古老傳說。

tmdb_overview: 「超拖」樂團雙人組有夠會拖，兩個懷著成名夢的好友，為了登上表演舞台，每天在破公寓談鋼琴練肖話，還找紀錄片團隊貼身側拍。只是十七年過去，少年變大叔，卻連場地預約電話都還沒打。他們以為只要幹場大事，例如跳下電視塔，成為話題，自然會被注意到。當計劃再度挫屎，習慣言聽計從的那個開始意識到，多年搭檔可能才是拖垮人生的雷包，於是打算拆夥落跑。誰知竟把箱型車開成時光機，陰錯陽差將所有人帶回十七年前的那一天！
tmdb_overview_en: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008.

movie_title: 魯冰花 數位修復版
synopsis: 魯冰花盛開時，美術老師郭雲天來到鄉間任教。他發現調皮搗蛋的古阿明，擁有充滿想像力的繪畫天賦，僅管家境貧困，仍用樂觀的筆畫下眼前所見。當他極力推舉阿明參加比賽，卻也不得不面對無奈的現實阻礙……。 改編自「臺灣文學之母」鍾肇政同名小說，由楊立國執導、吳念真編劇，透過從都市來到鄉間老師的視角，看見孩童之純粹、以及潛藏背後的貧富差距、僵化的教育體制、地方政治樣貌及農村發展問題，呈現一段來不及長大的悲劇。同名主題曲則伴隨熱淚故事，述說思念、傳唱不朽。
synopsis_en:
As the lupine flowers bloom, art teacher Guo Yuntian arrives in the countryside to begin his teaching post. There, he discovers Gu Aming, a mischievous boy with a vivid imagination and a natural talent for painting. Despite his family's poverty, Aming captures the world around him with an optimistic brush. But as Guo tries his best to nominate Aming for a competition, he is forced to confront the harsh and inevitable obstacles of reality.

Adapted from the novel of the same name by Zhong Zhaozheng, the "Mother of Taiwan Literature," and featuring a screenplay by Wu Nien-jen under the direction of Yang Liguo, the film views the world through the eyes of a city teacher. It captures the purity of childhood while exposing the underlying wealth gap, rigid educational systems, local politics, and rural development issues, ultimately presenting a tragedy of a life cut short. The film’s iconic theme song accompanies this tear-jerking story, speaking of longing and remaining a timeless classic.

synopsis: 淺野一二O 經典漫畫作品改編 芽衣子（宮崎葵 飾）與種田（高良健吾 飾）在大學因輕音社而相識，畢業後便展開了同居生活。芽衣子雖然順利成為上班族，卻對千篇一律的工作感到厭倦，對人生更是充滿迷惘。而懷抱音樂夢的種田則維持著一邊在雜誌社打工，一邊與好友共組名為「ROTTI」的樂團。眼看鼓手不得不繼承家業，平日顧著那間小小的藥房，貝斯手則是不想畢業，成了名副其實的六年級生，雖然整個樂團前途渺茫卻始終維持著每週團練。一場突如其來的變故，使得芽衣子決定踏上一條艱辛的道路。
tmdb_overview: 故事描述一起於大學畢業後的情侶：芽衣子和種田之間面對生活、興趣、未來、內心的困惑和煩惱。

synopsis: ★ 2019坎城影展最佳劇本獎 ★ 酷兒金棕櫚 首位女導演得主 18世紀的歐洲，才華洋溢的年輕女畫家瑪莉安（諾耶米・梅蘭特 飾演）收到委託，需要在對方不知情的狀況下，完成富家小姐艾洛伊茲（阿黛兒・艾奈爾 飾演）出嫁前的肖像畫。於是兩人在孤島相依為命，白天女畫家悄悄觀察小姐的一舉一動，到了晚上才縱情下筆。兩人在畫與被畫的親密接觸下，即便是在充滿禮教束縛的時代，卻也漸漸萌發了禁忌的曖昧情愫，隨著大婚之日越來越近，她們的愛火卻越燒越猛烈...

tmdb_overview: 18世紀的歐洲,才華洋溢的年輕女畫家瑪莉安收到委託,需要在對方不知情的狀況下,完成富家小姐艾洛伊茲出嫁前的肖像畫。兩人在孤島相依為命,白天女畫家悄悄觀察小姐的一舉一動,到了晚上才縱情下筆。兩人在畫與被畫的親密接觸下,即便是在充滿禮教束縛的時代,卻也漸漸萌發了禁忌的曖昧情愫,隨著大婚之日越來越近,她們的愛火卻越燒越猛烈……
tmdb_overview_en: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.

synopsis: 眼科醫師杜家珍化名吳小姐，在報紙上刊登徵婚啟事，吸引了各色男子。儘管周旋於不同陌生男子之間，她仍無法忘懷那段與已婚男子的舊情。名導陳國富改編同名小說，深入探討臺灣都市裡的寂寞芳心，結合劇情與紀錄片形式，並藉由歌手伍佰的本色演出，巧妙模糊虛實界限。

tmdb_overview: 杜家珍是一位眼科醫生，她的感情生活幾乎是一片空白，只有一個偷情的對象，是她好朋友的老公。在生活上最讓她焦慮的是孤獨與空虛，覺得自己年歲也差不多了，條件也不差，應該找個男人與她一起分享生命，因為她相信，只要敢把心聲高唱出來，知音終於是會出現的，但是這個男人在哪裡呢？接著三天在報紙上登出了她的「徵婚啟事」--------- 「生無悔、死無懼，不需經濟基礎，對離異無挫折感，願先友後婚，非介紹所，無誠勿試，電話22652752吳小姐洽」。
tmdb_overview_en: An attractive and successful doctor places a personal ad in a newspaper to try to meet (and eventually marry) Mr. Right. A succession of blind dates ensues, featuring men who are lonely, desperate, dangerous and perverted.

synopsis: 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常，透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。

synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

synopsis: 麥特和阿傑是一對懷抱音樂夢的超級死黨，一搭一唱組成超脫樂團（和那個傳奇樂團Nirvana無關）。兩人為了登上夢寐以求的舞台，想盡各種荒唐計畫，甚至爬上國家電視塔、跳傘空降巨蛋。十七年歲月過去，阿傑不免萌生「單飛比較紅」的念頭，某天麥特異想天開的時光機計劃竟弄假成真，帶他們穿越回2008年... 滿嘴幹話的落漆魯蛇，是否將迎來憨人出頭天的時刻？他們又該如何解決這次危機……。

tmdb_overview: 「超拖」樂團雙人組有夠會拖，兩個懷著成名夢的好友，為了登上表演舞台，每天在破公寓談鋼琴練肖話，還找紀錄片團隊貼身側拍。只是十七年過去，少年變大叔，卻連場地預約電話都還沒打。他們以為只要幹場大事，例如跳下電視塔，成為話題，自然會被注意到。當計劃再度挫屎，習慣言聽計從的那個開始意識到，多年搭檔可能才是拖垮人生的雷包，於是打算拆夥落跑。誰知竟把箱型車開成時光機，陰錯陽差將所有人帶回十七年前的那一天！
tmdb_overview_en: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008.

synopsis: 臺北某夜，白玫和丈夫道別後，漫步西區街頭，無意間遇到了多年失聯的傑克。陌生卻熟悉的交談間，曖昧又帶點疏離。等到阿信的出現，這過去三名曾經為了演員夢形影不離，且在這城市一起打拼的年輕人，重新聚在一起了。然而，這六年來的失聯，是因為他們的友誼不堪一擊，還是繽紛閃爍的城市足以沖刷一切？他們該如何在這一夜重逢，搭夥意外加入的毛毛，瞭解未曾道出的秘密，以及留在這裡或離開這裡的理由？

Fate reunites them tonight in the heart of Taipei, but they only have a few hours to uncover the secrets hidden in each other’s hearts.

synopsis: 下北澤，陷入創作地獄的劇團作家圓香來到Tollywood電影院，打算觀賞一部描述樂團團員意外捲入黑幫風波的電影《三軒茶屋大逃脫》。鄰鎮三軒茶屋的樂團成員和真則來到Tollywood，觀賞的是描述一個搞劇團的女孩捲進一場星際風波的電影《下北澤大逃亡》。對圓香而言，和真就是「電影」；對和真而言，圓香才是「電影」。當和真唸出手上傳單的劇情，精準預料了劇團成員背著圓香，打算進行密謀，兩人開始透過「劇透」與「暴雷」，一邊透過銀幕交談，一邊為了拯救各自即將面臨解散的樂團與劇團而奔走。但天馬行空的劇情發展，還有亂入的「茶澤抵抗軍」，似乎已經超乎了兩人最大的想像……。
tmdb_overview: 陷入創作地獄的舞台劇作家，打算暫離現況去隔壁看個電影喘口氣，當她走進空無一人的影廳，銀幕上的場景怎麼這麼熟悉？畫面中那個因為演唱會票房不佳而與團員吵架的團長，怎麼也坐在一模一樣的影廳內不發一語？觀眾跟角色像是大眼瞪小眼，「這到底是什麼爛片」才剛說出口，銀幕上的他竟回應了……？
tmdb_overview_en: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

synopsis: 繼《貧民百萬富翁》最感動電影《我們要回家》入選奧斯卡15強 印度北部的窮困小村，兩位形影不離的兒時好友——穆斯林青年修伊與低種姓青年前登。兩人的成長過程皆遭受歧視與壓迫，為找回被剝奪的尊嚴、扭轉命運，兩人決定報考警察。然而，激烈的競爭與漫長的歸途，終讓這段深厚的友誼面臨了崩解的危機。電影揭露印度低下階層的生存苦況與絕望感……。
tmdb_overview: 在印度北部一個小村莊裡，兩位兒時好友渴望成為警察，以此重拾長期被剝奪的尊嚴。然而，隨著他們一步步接近夢想，日益增長的絕望威脅著他們彼此之間的紐帶。
tmdb_overview_en: Two childhood friends from a small North Indian village chase a police job that promises them the dignity they’ve long been denied. But as they inch closer to their dream, mounting desperation threatens the bond that holds them together.

movie_title: 魯冰花 數位修復版
synopsis: 魯冰花盛開時，美術老師郭雲天來到鄉間任教。他發現調皮搗蛋的古阿明，擁有充滿想像力的繪畫天賦，僅管家境貧困，仍用樂觀的筆畫下眼前所見。當他極力推舉阿明參加比賽，卻也不得不面對無奈的現實阻礙……。 改編自「臺灣文學之母」鍾肇政同名小說，由楊立國執導、吳念真編劇，透過從都市來到鄉間老師的視角，看見孩童之純粹、以及潛藏背後的貧富差距、僵化的教育體制、地方政治樣貌及農村發展問題，呈現一段來不及長大的悲劇。同名主題曲則伴隨熱淚故事，述說思念、傳唱不朽。
synopsis_en:
As the lupine flowers bloom, art teacher Guo Yuntian arrives in the countryside to begin his teaching post. There, he discovers Gu Aming, a mischievous boy with a vivid imagination and a natural talent for painting. Despite his family's poverty, Aming captures the world around him with an optimistic brush. But as Guo tries his best to nominate Aming for a competition, he is forced to confront the harsh and inevitable obstacles of reality.

Adapted from the novel of the same name by Zhong Zhaozheng, the "Mother of Taiwan Literature," and featuring a screenplay by Wu Nien-jen under the direction of Yang Liguo, the film views the world through the eyes of a city teacher. It captures the purity of childhood while exposing the underlying wealth gap, rigid educational systems, local politics, and rural development issues, ultimately presenting a tragedy of a life cut short. The film’s iconic theme song accompanies this tear-jerking story, speaking of longing and remaining a timeless classic.

synopsis: 淺野一二O 經典漫畫作品改編 芽衣子（宮崎葵 飾）與種田（高良健吾 飾）在大學因輕音社而相識，畢業後便展開了同居生活。芽衣子雖然順利成為上班族，卻對千篇一律的工作感到厭倦，對人生更是充滿迷惘。而懷抱音樂夢的種田則維持著一邊在雜誌社打工，一邊與好友共組名為「ROTTI」的樂團。眼看鼓手不得不繼承家業，平日顧著那間小小的藥房，貝斯手則是不想畢業，成了名副其實的六年級生，雖然整個樂團前途渺茫卻始終維持著每週團練。一場突如其來的變故，使得芽衣子決定踏上一條艱辛的道路。
tmdb_overview: 故事描述一起於大學畢業後的情侶：芽衣子和種田之間面對生活、興趣、未來、內心的困惑和煩惱。
tmdb_overview_en: Meiko and Taneda are a couple graduated from university two years ago. Unhappy with their lives, Meiko quits her job and encourages Taneda to have his band become professional.

synopsis: 多部純子與女子登山隊成員們奔波募款，為的是那一場聖母峰的遠征之夢。即便步入婚姻、成家育兒，她也未曾放下對大山的執著，這份堅毅使她成為無數女性眼中的希望之光。1975年，女子登山隊正式挑戰世界之巔。路途中遭遇雪崩重創，純子最終成為唯一一名邁向終點的登山者。她成為全球首位登頂聖母峰的女性，這項壯舉讓全世界為之震驚。然而，聚光燈帶來的名望卻成為一把雙面刃。鎂光燈過度聚焦於純子一人，導致她與隊友間產生難以彌補的隔閡……。

tmdb_overview_en: In 1975, a woman reached the summit of Mount Everest: Junko, the first woman in history to reach the world's highest peak. synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

synopsis: 27歲腐女由嘉里（杉咲花 飾）多年來把所有熱情都用在追動漫、同人文上，卻始終無法喜歡真正的自己。因擔心自己孤老終生而開始相親。一次聯誼慘敗後，爛醉的她在歌舞伎町被厭世女公關「萊」（南琴奈 飾）出手相救，兩人就此展開同居生活。在萊的帶領下，由嘉里看見了全新的世界。她陸續認識王牌牛郎朝日（板垣李光人 飾）、高冷的毒舌女作家有希（蒼井優 飾），以及酒吧老闆阿新哥（澀谷清彥 飾），與眾人一起在五光十色的歌舞伎町縱情大笑的日子，讓由嘉里找到了久違的歸屬感。然而，每當看著老將「死亡」掛在嘴邊的萊，由嘉里總是無比擔心，於是她決定要不顧一切幫助萊重拾活下去的勇氣。一場關於愛、陪伴與生命抉擇的考驗隨之展開。 A human drama set in Shinjuku's Kabukicho district, depicting a world shaped by new encounters. Directed by Matsui Daigo, who is known for films such as Remain in Twilight and Just Remembering. Yukari (Sugisaki Hana) adores the manga "Meat Is Mine", but she can't bring herself to like herself. Watching her friends leave one after another due to marriage, childbirth, and other life events, she feels anxiety and impatience about continuing to live this way. One day, while passed out drunk in Kabukicho, she is rescued by Rai (Minami Kotona), a hostess harboring suicidal thoughts.

tmdb_overview_en: Yukari, a 27-year old fujoshi fangirl who loves the popular yakiniku-themed pretty boy anime "Meat is Mine", ends up meeting Rai, a pretty but enigmatic bar hostess. As they become friends and roommates in Kabukicho, Yukari starts to get concerned about how Rai doesn't take care of herself and keeps talking about death. Yukari wants to make Rai less suicidal by finding her ex-boyfriend, who she suspects Rai still isn't over.  At the same time Yukari attempts to date a decent guy, pressured by her mother and thinking that love might be the answer to set her life straight. Nevertheless, she ends up spending a lot of time with Rai's friend Asahi, a cheery and friendly (but married) host club boy.  Based on the novel by Hitomi Kanehara.

synopsis: 1945年8月15日，日本透過「玉音放送」宣布無條件接受波茲坦宣言，第二次世界大戰正式結束。對當時生活在福爾摩沙的台灣人民來說，這一天也終結了他們原本認知的世界。日本對台灣的殖民統治因戰敗而崩解，而當了五十年「日本人」的台灣島民一夜之間成了「中國人」，在中日交戰夾縫下的台灣，一夕之間從戰敗國成為戰勝國。 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常：在前線奮戰的軍屬、造飛機的少年工、戰場看護助手、想成為文化教育者的師範生，以及無數因為戰爭打亂生活的尋常百姓。本片運用最先進的上色技術，將黑白的歷史資料片轉為彩色，重現栩栩如生的真實感；經過精心的音效設計，復原默片影像完整的音場；透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。 《終戰那一天》不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。 電影預告 其他熱映
tmdb_overview: 《終戰那一天》挖掘了失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。
synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

synopsis: 日本金像獎影后 宮澤理惠 x 南韓人氣男星 路雲 驚喜加盟 日劇原班人馬 永瀨廉、今田美櫻、吉田羊 等強勢回歸 福山雅治親自演唱電影主題曲《木星》搖滾天團 B'z 主唱 稻葉浩志 跨刀填詞合作 全盲的FBI搜查官皆實廣見，人稱「Last Man」的最後王牌。與他搭檔的則是警視廳搜查一課的幹練刑警護道心太朗。這對所向披靡的黃金拍檔，這次因任務遠赴北海道，在那寒冷的北國，皆實意外重逢了他的初戀情人。 身為世界級天才工程師的渚，因掌握了足以改變世界的關鍵技術，正面臨神祕組織的跨國追殺。為了守護初戀情人並查明真相，皆實與心太朗再次聯手，並與警視廳、FBI新派遣的探員、CIA以及北海道警方組成美日聯合搜查團隊。

synopsis_en:
Japan Academy Film Prize winner Rie Miyazawa and popular South Korean actor Rowoon join the original TV series cast—including Ren Nagase, Mio Imada, and Yo Yoshida—for a powerful return to the screen. The film features the theme song "Jupiter," performed by Masaharu Fukuyama with lyrics by Koshi Inaba, lead singer of the legendary rock band B'z.

Hiromi Minami is a blind FBI agent known as the "Last Man," the ultimate ace of the bureau. Partnered with the skilled Detective Shintaro Godo of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department’s First Investigation Division, the invincible duo heads to Hokkaido for a new mission. In the frozen north, Minami unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Nagisa. A world-class genius engineer, Nagisa is being hunted across borders by a mysterious organization for possessing technology that could change the world. To protect his first love and uncover the truth, Minami and Godo join forces with a joint US-Japan investigation team comprising the MPD, newly dispatched FBI agents, the CIA, and the Hokkaido police.

synopsis: 拉札洛是一位單純善良的年輕農民，在與世隔絕的義大利小城內生活著，他和驕縱叛逆的莊園少爺坦奎迪，從雇傭關係意外結為好友。某天，坦奎迪自導自演了一齣無聊的綁架鬧劇，沒料到卻在這鬧劇中衍生出另一場意外，讓拉札洛穿越時空到多年以後，在人事已非的狀況下，他要如何面對這毫無所知的新世界呢？ 義大利名導艾莉絲羅爾瓦雀魔幻寫實力作，榮獲坎城影展最佳劇本獎。以純樸的義大利鄉村做為背景的寓言故事，透過魔幻寫實手法，淬煉出純真與黑暗、善良與貪婪，將現代都市化的悲歌，昇華成無法言喻而發人深省的古老傳說。
tmdb_overview: 故事描述拉扎洛是一位內心單純的年輕農民在一個與世隔絕的義大利小城內生活，與個性驕縱的莊園少爺坦奎迪從雇傭關係意外結為好友。某天，坦奎迪自導自演了一場無聊的綁架鬧劇，沒料到卻在這鬧劇中衍生出另一場意外，讓拉扎洛穿越時空到多年以後，他要如何面對毫無所知的新世界呢？

synopsis: A24全新力作，還原70年代廚房的火爆、高壓與純粹 19歲的東尼（多明尼克塞薩 飾）一心嚮往成為作家，在1975年夏天，為了初戀南西（艾蜜莉雅瓊斯 飾）踏入美國鱈魚角普洛文斯敦一間濱海餐廳的廚房打工洗碗。在餐廳老闆「主廚」（安東尼奧班德拉斯 飾）嚴厲卻真誠的調教下，對料理一竅不通的東尼，逐漸蛻變成對美食充滿狂熱的年輕廚師；而闖蕩江湖的夥伴沙爾（李奧伍道爾 飾）則帶著他一頭栽進酒精、菸草與放縱交織的世界。 在這個瘋狂而炙熱的夏天，東尼第一次嚐到了未來的滋味——那些關於愛、背叛、友情與自我認同的碰撞，讓他第一次明白自己想要成為什麼樣的人。這份熾熱的初心，正是日後撼動全球美食界傳奇名廚的最初起點。

synopsis: | 普 東京國際影展開幕片 香港亞洲電影節 聖賽巴斯提安國際影展 多部純子與女子登山隊成員們奔波募款，為的是那一場聖母峰的遠征之夢。即便步入婚姻、成家育兒，她也未曾放下對大山的執著，這份堅毅使她成為無數女性眼中的希望之光。1975年，女子登山隊正式挑戰世界之巔。路途中遭遇雪崩重創，純子最終成為唯一一名邁向終點的登山者。她成為全球首位登頂聖母峰的女性，這項壯舉讓全世界為之震驚。然而，聚光燈帶來的名望卻成為一把雙面刃。鎂光燈過度聚焦於純子一人，導致她與隊友間產生難以彌補的隔閡。2010年，純子被確診為腹膜癌末期。面對生死關頭，她依然保持豁達，依舊與老友悅子在星空下共度露營時光。對她而言，抗癌就像是人生的另一場攀登，她決定燃燒餘生，向更高的人心巔峰挑戰。即便生活充滿挑戰，純子始終用笑容溫暖身邊的人。在作為登山家、母親與妻子的多重身分中，純子在生命的最後一刻，在那座心靈的巔峰之上，究竟看見了什麼樣的風景？ Drama that reunites director Sakamoto Junji and actress Yoshinaga Sayuri for the first time since A Chorus of Angels 13 years ago. Portrays a heroine inspired by Tabei Junko, the first woman to successfully scale Mount Everest, and her family. In 1975, Tabe Junko conquered the world's highest summit. However, that incredible achievement not only pointed the spotlight at her friends and family, but also cast a deep shadow. In her later years, Junko (Yoshinaga) was diagnosed with a terminal illness, but she continued to full-heartedly embrace the challenge of mountain climbing.

tmdb_overview_en: Yukari, a 27-year old fujoshi fangirl who loves the popular yakiniku-themed pretty boy anime "Meat is Mine", ends up meeting Rai, a pretty but enigmatic bar hostess. As they become friends and roommates in Kabukicho, Yukari starts to get concerned about how Rai doesn't take care of herself and keeps talking about death. Yukari wants to make Rai less suicidal by finding her ex-boyfriend, who she suspects Rai still isn't over.  At the same time Yukari attempts to date a decent guy, pressured by her mother and thinking that love might be the answer to set her life straight. Nevertheless, she ends up spending a lot of time with Rai's friend Asahi, a cheery and friendly (but married) host club boy.  Based on the novel by Hitomi Kanehara.

synopsis_en: Drawing inspiration from five hexagrams of the I Ching, five animation directors fuse Taiwanese culture into five independent chapters, each distinct in style and theme. These stories interweave tradition and the future, faith and raw emotion, creating a singularity where science fiction meets reality. Within the boundless void of animation, a space adventure drifting through the cosmos, a pilgrimage train for "Incense Lamp Warriors," a digital transcendence of the physical form, and a youthful romance set in a cold, post-apocalyptic wasteland vividly come to life at the intersection of the virtual and the real.

synopsis_en: During the Ming Dynasty, the high-ranking official Yang Lian is murdered by the eunuch Men Da of the Eastern Depot. His descendant, Yang Huizhen, along with General Shi and other members of the Donglin faction, are relentlessly pursued by the secret agent Ouyang Nian. While in hiding, Yang develops a romantic bond with the scholar Gu Shengzhai, and through Gu’s strategic brilliance, they manage to outwit and defeat their pursuers. After giving birth to a son, Huizhen secretly leaves Gu, seeking to renounce the world and enter a Buddhist monastery. As the first Chinese-language film to win an award at one of the three major European film festivals, its iconic bamboo forest duel has profoundly influenced directors such as Ang Lee, Zhang Yimou, and Tsui Hark.

synopsis: 《世界上最爛的人》導演尤沃金提爾，一鳴驚人首部作品重返大銀幕 伊利和菲利普這對好友都夢想成為作家，就在他們相約寄出作品初稿後，兩人的際遇卻截然不同：菲利普憑著出眾才氣，瞬間在挪威藝文圈爆紅，甚至談起新戀情，不料這番突如其來的轉變卻讓他莫名陷入憂鬱深淵；伊利雖遭出版社婉拒，反而激勵了他繼續朝著夢想前進。半年過去，菲利普雖已痊癒，戀情卻也岌岌可危，渴望再一次擁抱愛情的他，還有重新來過的可能嗎？而立志要在文壇發光發熱的伊利，最終能如願成為一名作家嗎？
tmdb_overview: 伊利和菲利普這對死黨都懷著作家夢，他們相約寄出第一部作品後，迎來了截然不同的際遇。菲利普憑著過人才氣在文壇迅速竄紅，卻又瞬間陷入憂鬱；伊利雖然出師不利，但他仍不放棄地持續努力。半年後，菲利普的狀況改善許多，伊利的寫作技巧也突飛猛進，但兩人的未來會就此一帆風順嗎？

synopsis: 2023 日舞影展 Sundance FF 2023 柏林影展 Berlinale 2023 金馬影展 Taipei Golden Horse FF 籍籍無名小說家詹姆斯與妻子來到孤島上的奢華度假村，自稱書迷的魅惑女子邀請他們違規踏出度假村邊界探險，卻意外捲入一 場致命車禍 。在 這個對犯罪「零容忍」的異域國度，詹姆斯面臨殘酷的法律抉擇：你必須接受處決，或者，如果你夠富有，可以花錢製造自己的複製人，並親眼看著「自己」代替自己死去。 加拿大驚悚鬼才布蘭登柯能堡承繼父親大衛柯能堡風格，於異想世界將階級特權、殖民式觀光與道德崩解推向極致，以極具作者風格的視覺迷幻感，刻劃蕩然無存的人性道德底線。其「恐怖片繆思」米亞高斯交出令人驚艷的狂放演出，與瑞典演員亞歷山大史柯斯嘉共同編織出放縱且血腥的當代邪惡。 At a luxury island resort, obscure novelist James is lured outside the gates by a seductive fan, triggering a fatal accident. In this zero-tolerance nation, he must be executed—or, if rich enough, pay to watch his clone die instead. Inheriting his father David Cronenberg's profound interest in body horror, Brandon Cronenberg pushes class privilege and colonial tourism to a surreal extreme. Mia Goth's stunningly wild performance alongside Alexander Skarsgård weaves a psychedelic, bloody nightmare of absolute moral decay.

tmdb_overview_en: While staying at an isolated island resort, James and Em are enjoying a perfect vacation of pristine beaches, exceptional staff, and soaking up the sun. But guided by the seductive and mysterious Gabi, they venture outside the resort grounds and find themselves in a culture filled with violence, hedonism, and untold horror. A tragic accident leaves them facing a zero tolerance policy for crime: either you'll be executed, or, if you’re rich enough to afford it, you can watch yourself die instead.

tmdb_overview: 19歲的東尼一心嚮往成為作家，在1975年夏天，為了初戀南西踏入美國鱈魚角普洛文斯敦一間濱海餐廳的廚房打工洗碗。在餐廳老闆「主廚」嚴厲卻真誠的調教下，對料理一竅不通的東尼，逐漸蛻變成對美食充滿狂熱的年輕廚師；而闖蕩江湖的夥伴沙爾則帶著他一頭栽進酒精、菸草與放縱交織的世界。在這個瘋狂而炙熱的夏天，東尼第一次嚐到了未來的滋味——那些關於愛、背叛、友情與自我認同的碰撞，讓他第一次明白自己想要成為什麼樣的人。這份熾熱的初心，正是日後撼動全球美食界傳奇名廚的最初起點。

Directed by Matsui Daigo, who is known for films such as Remain in Twilight and Just Remembering. Yukari (Sugisaki Hana) adores the manga "Meat Is Mine", but she can't bring herself to like herself. Watching her friends leave one after another due to marriage, childbirth, and other life events, she feels anxiety and impatience about continuing to live this way. One day, while passed out drunk in Kabukicho, she is rescued by Rai (Minami Kotona), a hostess harboring suicidal thoughts.

tmdb_overview_en: Yukari, a 27-year old fujoshi fangirl who loves the popular yakiniku-themed pretty boy anime "Meat is Mine", ends up meeting Rai, a pretty but enigmatic bar hostess. As they become friends and roommates in Kabukicho, Yukari starts to get concerned about how Rai doesn't take care of herself and keeps talking about death. Yukari wants to make Rai less suicidal by finding her ex-boyfriend, who she suspects Rai still isn't over.  At the same time Yukari attempts to date a decent guy, pressured by her mother and thinking that love might be the answer to set her life straight. Nevertheless, she ends up spending a lot of time with Rai's friend Asahi, a cheery and friendly (but married) host club boy.  Based on the novel by Hitomi Kanehara.

synopsis: 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常，透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。

synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

synopsis: 1945年8月15日，日本透過「玉音放送」宣布無條件接受波茲坦宣言，第二次世界大戰正式結束。對當時生活在福爾摩沙的台灣人民來說，這一天也終結了他們原本認知的世界。日本對台灣的殖民統治因戰敗而崩解，而當了五十年「日本人」的台灣島民一夜之間成了「中國人」，在中日交戰夾縫下的台灣，一夕之間從戰敗國成為戰勝國。 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常：在前線奮戰的軍屬、造飛機的少年工、戰場看護助手、想成為文化教育者的師範生，以及無數因為戰爭打亂生活的尋常百姓。本片運用最先進的上色技術，將黑白的歷史資料片轉為彩色，重現栩栩如生的真實感；經過精心的音效設計，復原默片影像完整的音場；透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。 《終戰那一天》不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。 電影預告 其他熱映

Nevertheless, she ends up spending a lot of time with Rai's friend Asahi, a cheery and friendly (but married) host club boy.  Based on the novel by Hitomi Kanehara.

synopsis: ★A24全新力作，還原70年代廚房的火爆、高壓與純粹 ★麥特強森狂放執導，以不綁安全帶的手法直擊職人靈魂 ★安東尼奧班德拉斯攜手話題新星多明尼克塞薩，演繹亦師亦父的靈魂羈絆 ★一個夏天、一間廚房、一群瘋子——「在最糟糕的環境中，找到一生熱愛」的熱血成長故事 ★取材自傳奇名廚
tmdb_overview: 19歲的東尼一心嚮往成為作家，在1975年夏天，為了初戀南西踏入美國鱈魚角普洛文斯敦一間濱海餐廳的廚房打工洗碗。在餐廳老闆「主廚」嚴厲卻真誠的調教下，對料理一竅不通的東尼，逐漸蛻變成對美食充滿狂熱的年輕廚師；而闖蕩江湖的夥伴沙爾則帶著他一頭栽進酒精、菸草與放縱交織的世界。在這個瘋狂而炙熱的夏天，東尼第一次嚐到了未來的滋味——那些關於愛、背叛、友情與自我認同的碰撞，讓他第一次明白自己想要成為什麼樣的人。這份熾熱的初心，正是日後撼動全球美食界傳奇名廚的最初起點。
tmdb_overview_en: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

director: Kevin Geiger  X  劉育樹  X  黃瀛洲  X  廖偉智  X  連亞珏
synopsis: 五位動畫導演以《易經》五卦為引，融合台灣文化，幻化孕育出五個風格與題材各異的獨立故事篇章，交織傳統與未來、信仰與真情、科幻與現實的內爆奇點。在動畫虛空中，漂流宇宙的太空冒險、香燈勇者的遶境列車、肉身超脫的電子穿越、世界末日冷酷異境的青春浪漫，在虛實交錯之間一一絢麗具現。
synopsis_en: Drawing inspiration from five hexagrams of the I Ching, five animation directors fuse Taiwanese culture into five independent chapters, each distinct in style and theme. These stories interweave tradition and the future, faith and raw emotion, creating a singularity where science fiction meets reality. Within the boundless void of animation, a space adventure drifting through the cosmos, a pilgrimage train for "Incense Lamp Warriors," a digital transcendence of the physical form, and a youthful romance set in a cold, post-apocalyptic wasteland vividly come to life at the intersection of the virtual and the real.

synopsis: ◎2026奧斯卡最佳國際電影15強 ◎2025坎城影展「一種注目」競賽片 ◎寶萊塢銀幕獎最佳影片等15項大獎提名 ◎印度年度最佳導演、最佳女主角雙料大獎 ◎印度影評人選擇獎最佳影片、最佳導演、最佳男主角、最佳女配角4項大獎
tmdb_overview: 在印度北部一個小村莊裡，兩位兒時好友渴望成為警察，以此重拾長期被剝奪的尊嚴。然而，隨著他們一步步接近夢想，日益增長的絕望威脅著他們彼此之間的紐帶。
tmdb_overview_en: Two childhood friends from a small North Indian village chase a police job that promises them the dignity they’ve long been denied. But as they inch closer to their dream, mounting desperation threatens the bond that holds them together.

synopsis_en:
🌊 **2026 Backstreet Culture Festival: "Making Waves" – Event Guide** 🌊

🔥🔥 **The Backstreet Culture Festival Heatwave is Here!** 🔥🔥

The 2026 Backstreet Culture Festival: "Making Waves" is set to take the stage this summer! 🌊✨ This year’s theme, "Making Waves," focuses on urban street culture and youth creative energy. Through street dance, music, markets, and interactive experiences, we are creating a summer street culture extravaganza! 🎶🔥

When the rhythm starts and creativity converges, everyone becomes part of the tide, injecting new vitality and imagination into the neighborhood. 🌊❤️‍🔥 This summer, step into the backstreets and use sound, rhythm, and passion to make waves of our own!

Featuring "Double Helix," the only top-tier performance team in Taiwan to fuse jump rope with street dance. ⚡️🤸 Jump rope isn't just a calorie-burning exercise; it’s an extension of physical rhythm and street style.

⟣ **Instructor** | Una

synopsis: 2018 威尼斯影展 Venice FF 2019 美國獨立精神獎最佳攝影、勞勃阿特曼獎 Best Cinematography & Robert Altman Award, Independent Spirit Awards 2019 美國獨立精神獎最佳攝影、勞勃阿特曼獎 Best Cinematography & Robert Altman Award, Independent Spirit Awards 2020 葛萊美獎入圍最佳創作影視媒體歌曲 Nominated for Best Song Written for Visual Media, Grammy Awards 滿懷志向的舞蹈新秀蘇西進入柏林頂尖舞蹈學校，藝術總監對她的表現非常青睞，想將她培養成下一個明日之星。但隨著蘇西一步步取代舞團首席，她也漸漸發現學校深處的腥風血雨。氛圍詭譎，怪事連連，越來越害怕的蘇西，即將揭開芭蕾舞蹈名校中令人毛骨悚然的黑暗歷史⋯⋯。 名列「影史十大恐怖片」之一的1977年義大利驚悚經典《坐立不安》，在上映40週年推出全新版本《窒息》，將背景置於1977年冷戰時期的柏林，以政治動盪與納粹陰影的歷史隱喻，融合了女性主義、民間傳說與肉體恐怖，解構戰後集體創傷。由《以你的名字呼喚我》導演盧卡格達戈尼諾執導，找來合作多年的蒂妲史雲頓一人飾演三個角色，電影配樂更由天團電台司令主唱湯姆約克獻出處女作，呈現視、聽覺震撼的當代驚慄作品。 Aspiring dancer Susie joins a prestigious Berlin academy, quickly becoming the artistic director's protégé. But as she replaces the lead dancer, she uncovers the school's horrifying, bloody history. Reimagining the horror classic, director Luca Guadagnino anchors this contemporary nightmare in 1977 Cold War Berlin to deconstruct post-war collective trauma. Blending feminism, folklore, and visceral body horror, the film features a stunning triple performance by Tilda Swinton and a haunting score by Thom Yorke.

Yukari wants to make Rai less suicidal by finding her ex-boyfriend, who she suspects Rai still isn't over.  At the same time Yukari attempts to date a decent guy, pressured by her mother and thinking that love might be the answer to set her life straight. synopsis: 2026 金球獎最佳原創音樂、電影與票房成就獎 Best Original Score & Best Cinematic and Box Office Achievement, Golden Globes 2026 英國影藝學院獎最佳女配角、原著劇本、原創音樂 Best Actress in a Supporting Role, Best Original Screenplay & Best Original Score, BAFTA 2026 奧斯卡金像獎最佳男主角、原著劇本、攝影、原創音樂 Best Actor, Best Original Screenplay, Best Cinematography & Best Original Score, Academy Awards 1930年代的密西西比三角洲，籠罩著種族隔離的陰影。一對雙胞胎兄弟回到南方故鄉開設地下酒館（Juke Joint），試圖為非裔社群打造一處自由的音樂庇護所。然而，被廣袤棉花田與殖民大宅包圍的故土，並未成為他們預期的避風港。當藍調吉他聲響起，不僅召喚出跨越時空的文化幻影，也引來了恐怖的不速之客——一個正被原住民喬克托族（Choctaw）獵殺、背負殖民歷史宿命的愛爾蘭吸血鬼。 導演萊恩庫格勒將真實歷史與祖靈感應注入其中， 並讓一群被社會歸類為「非我族類」的人們，遇上了處於「非生亦非死」狀態的吸血鬼，來延續導演 在《黑豹》中探討的非裔離散社群集體憤怒與哀傷，深刻挖掘白人霸權、文化掠奪與原住民土地剝削創傷交織的時代氛圍。麥可B喬丹一人分飾兩角，挑戰風格截然不同的雙胞胎兄弟，精彩絕倫的演出更助他 首次登上奧斯卡 影帝寶座。

tmdb_overview_en: Junior high school student Yuki, a member of a travelling theater troupe, changes schools every month for performances. Because of this, he does not expect to meet people at any of his schools and does not try to make friends. However, when he attends a new school, his homeroom teacher asks him to deliver something to a classmate who hasn't been coming to school, but has excellent grades. By chance, he becomes friends with him, and Ken's ex-girlfriend Maya joins them, and as the three of them spend more and more time together, Yuki begins to wish that they could see him on stage as an actor.

tmdb_overview: 父親過世後，納伊姆與母親搬到一座保守的宗教小鎮，試圖展開全新生活。在這裡，他結識了俊美少年萊恩，一段無法見容於世的戀情悄然萌芽。然而，當納伊姆意外撞見萊恩與牧師之子杭特難以啟齒的祕密後，他因為心生嫉妒而揭發真相。杭特的父母隨即請來驅魔師，企圖透過驅逐同性慾望的儀式來「矯正」兩人。沒想到，這場儀式非但沒有帶來救贖，反而誘發出詭異的超自然力量……
tmdb_overview_en: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

synopsis: ★ 韓國第62屆百想藝術大賞大黑馬  最佳導演 、 最佳女子新人獎 17歲少女一句氣話，竟引發了一場軒然大波。神祕的高中女孩「主仁」是一個開朗的朋友、厚臉皮的女兒、愛惡作劇的女友，同時也讓人難以預測。某天，一次同學發起的反對性侵犯重返社區的連署中，她不僅拒絕配合，還說詞反覆，讓大家開始猜疑起事件的真相，教室抽屜也出現了匿名恐嚇紙條…。只想守護自己世界的主仁，還能回到從前的樣子嗎？
tmdb_overview: 高三的女孩正值情慾萌芽與探索自我時期，同學眼中的她活潑外向、百無禁忌，卻在一次反對性侵犯重返社區的連署中，展現截然不同的一面。她拒絕配合、說詞反覆，讓大家開始猜疑。
tmdb_overview_en: Jooin, a 17-year-old student confused by love, unleashes chaos with some words spoken in a moment of anger. Anonymous notes questioning her actions begin to arrive, altering her quiet life.

synopsis: 淺野一二O 經典漫畫作品改編 芽衣子（宮崎葵 飾）與種田（高良健吾 飾）在大學因輕音社而相識，畢業後便展開了同居生活。芽衣子雖然順利成為上班族，卻對千篇一律的工作感到厭倦，對人生更是充滿迷惘。而懷抱音樂夢的種田則維持著一邊在雜誌社打工，一邊與好友共組名為「ROTTI」的樂團。眼看鼓手不得不繼承家業，平日顧著那間小小的藥房，貝斯手則是不想畢業，成了名副其實的六年級生，雖然整個樂團前途渺茫卻始終維持著每週團練。一場突如其來的變故，使得芽衣子決定踏上一條艱辛的道路。
tmdb_overview: 故事描述一起於大學畢業後的情侶：芽衣子和種田之間面對生活、興趣、未來、內心的困惑和煩惱。
tmdb_overview_en: Meiko and Taneda are a couple graduated from university two years ago. Unhappy with their lives, Meiko quits her job and encourages Taneda to have his band become professional.

movie_title: Last Man ー全盲搜查官ー 劇場版
synopsis: 日本金像獎影后 宮澤理惠 x 南韓人氣男星 路雲 驚喜加盟 日劇原班人馬 永瀨廉、今田美櫻、吉田羊 等強勢回歸 福山雅治親自演唱電影主題曲《木星》搖滾天團 B'z 主唱 稻葉浩志 跨刀填詞合作 全盲的FBI搜查官皆實廣見，人稱「Last Man」的最後王牌。與他搭檔的則是警視廳搜查一課的幹練刑警護道心太朗。這對所向披靡的黃金拍檔，這次因任務遠赴北海道，在那寒冷的北國，皆實意外重逢了他的初戀情人。 身為世界級天才工程師的渚，因掌握了足以改變世界的關鍵技術，正面臨神祕組織的跨國追殺。為了守護初戀情人並查明真相，皆實與心太朗再次聯手，並與警視廳、FBI新派遣的探員、CIA以及北海道警方組成美日聯合搜查團隊。

synopsis_en:
Japan Academy Film Prize winner Rie Miyazawa and popular South Korean actor Rowoon join the original TV series cast—including Ren Nagase, Mio Imada, and Yo Yoshida—for a powerful return to the screen. The film features the theme song "Jupiter," performed by Masaharu Fukuyama with lyrics by Koshi Inaba, lead singer of the legendary rock band B'z.

Hiromi Minami is a blind FBI agent known as the "Last Man," the ultimate ace of the bureau. Partnered with the skilled Detective Shintaro Godo of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department’s First Investigation Division, the invincible duo heads to Hokkaido for a new mission. In the frozen north, Minami unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Nagisa. A world-class genius engineer, Nagisa is being hunted across borders by a mysterious organization for possessing technology that could change the world. To protect his first love and uncover the truth, Minami and Godo join forces with a joint US-Japan investigation team comprising the MPD, newly dispatched FBI agents, the CIA, and the Hokkaido police.

tmdb_overview: 「人可生如蟻而美如神」：一班裁製亮麗戲服的中年裁縫慨嘆自己生如蟻，一名奧斯卡導演拍出她們美如神的生命。導演邀請了 18 位他最熱愛、且在義大利影壇極具分量的女演員，重塑一家高級裁縫工作室色彩斑斕、五味雜陳的過往，追憶70年代一班堅毅溫柔的女裁縫的故事。 一群日常女子拋開小我、互相照顧，照亮平凡生活中超越自我的不平凡，展現她們的獨立、愛慾、掙扎和力量。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.

synopsis: | 普 東京國際影展開幕片 香港亞洲電影節 聖賽巴斯提安國際影展 多部純子與女子登山隊成員們奔波募款，為的是那一場聖母峰的遠征之夢。即便步入婚姻、成家育兒，她也未曾放下對大山的執著，這份堅毅使她成為無數女性眼中的希望之光。1975年，女子登山隊正式挑戰世界之巔。路途中遭遇雪崩重創，純子最終成為唯一一名邁向終點的登山者。她成為全球首位登頂聖母峰的女性，這項壯舉讓全世界為之震驚。然而，聚光燈帶來的名望卻成為一把雙面刃。鎂光燈過度聚焦於純子一人，導致她與隊友間產生難以彌補的隔閡。2010年，純子被確診為腹膜癌末期。面對生死關頭，她依然保持豁達，依舊與老友悅子在星空下共度露營時光。對她而言，抗癌就像是人生的另一場攀登，她決定燃燒餘生，向更高的人心巔峰挑戰。即便生活充滿挑戰，純子始終用笑容溫暖身邊的人。在作為登山家、母親與妻子的多重身分中，純子在生命的最後一刻，在那座心靈的巔峰之上，究竟看見了什麼樣的風景？ Drama that reunites director Sakamoto Junji and actress Yoshinaga Sayuri for the first time since A Chorus of Angels 13 years ago. Portrays a heroine inspired by Tabei Junko, the first woman to successfully scale Mount Everest, and her family. In 1975, Tabe Junko conquered the world's highest summit. However, that incredible achievement not only pointed the spotlight at her friends and family, but also cast a deep shadow. In her later years, Junko (Yoshinaga) was diagnosed with a terminal illness, but she continued to full-heartedly embrace the challenge of mountain climbing.

Despite being diagnosed with a terminal illness in her final years, Junko continued to challenge the mountains. What was the last thing she saw beyond the summit?

synopsis: ★A24全新力作，還原70年代廚房的火爆、高壓與純粹 ★麥特強森狂放執導，以不綁安全帶的手法直擊職人靈魂 ★安東尼奧班德拉斯攜手話題新星多明尼克塞薩，演繹亦師亦父的靈魂羈絆 ★一個夏天、一間廚房、一群瘋子——「在最糟糕的環境中，找到一生熱愛」的熱血成長故事 ★取材自傳奇名廚
tmdb_overview: 19歲的東尼一心嚮往成為作家，在1975年夏天，為了初戀南西踏入美國鱈魚角普洛文斯敦一間濱海餐廳的廚房打工洗碗。在餐廳老闆「主廚」嚴厲卻真誠的調教下，對料理一竅不通的東尼，逐漸蛻變成對美食充滿狂熱的年輕廚師；而闖蕩江湖的夥伴沙爾則帶著他一頭栽進酒精、菸草與放縱交織的世界。在這個瘋狂而炙熱的夏天，東尼第一次嚐到了未來的滋味——那些關於愛、背叛、友情與自我認同的碰撞，讓他第一次明白自己想要成為什麼樣的人。這份熾熱的初心，正是日後撼動全球美食界傳奇名廚的最初起點。
tmdb_overview_en: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

synopsis: 1945年8月15日，日本透過「玉音放送」宣布無條件接受波茲坦宣言，第二次世界大戰正式結束。對當時生活在福爾摩沙的台灣人民來說，這一天也終結了他們原本認知的世界。日本對台灣的殖民統治因戰敗而崩解，而當了五十年「日本人」的台灣島民一夜之間成了「中國人」，在中日交戰夾縫下的台灣，一夕之間從戰敗國成為戰勝國。 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常：在前線奮戰的軍屬、造飛機的少年工、戰場看護助手、想成為文化教育者的師範生，以及無數因為戰爭打亂生活的尋常百姓。本片運用最先進的上色技術，將黑白的歷史資料片轉為彩色，重現栩栩如生的真實感；經過精心的音效設計，復原默片影像完整的音場；透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。 《終戰那一天》不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。 電影預告 其他熱映

synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

synopsis: ★ 感動法國逾44萬觀眾 票房破億的第六感浪漫奇蹟 浪漫之都巴黎，安寧病房醫師艾莎，從小就能看見亡者，並陪伴他們走完人生最後一程。她比誰都靠近死亡，愛情也總是因此無疾而終。某夜，才華洋溢的音樂人奧斯卡意外闖進她的生命，彷彿全世界只有她能真正看見他；而這個讓她重新相信愛的人，其實早已不屬於人間。 　　當死去的人還沒學會告別，活著的人也還沒學會活著，兩個孤獨靈魂在巴黎夜色中相遇，展開一場荒謬、浪漫又淚光閃閃的奇蹟旅程。感人熱淚堪稱現代版《第六感生死戀》，今年鬼門開，邀你見證一場從愛而生的告別。 電影預告 其他熱映 now showing

tmdb_overview_en: At 20, Ling balances boxing and helping with her mother's lunchbox business, all while her family quietly unravels. Her parents fake harmony, but when her father brings home a new "girlfriend," the illusion is shattered. Refusing to look away, Ling endures the blows - bloodied and tear-streaked. In facing reality head-on, she discovers a deeper truth: only with honesty in her heart do her punches carry real weight.

synopsis_en:
Japan Academy Film Prize winner Rie Miyazawa and popular South Korean actor Rowoon join the original TV series cast—including Ren Nagase, Mio Imada, and Yo Yoshida—for a powerful return to the screen. The film features the theme song "Jupiter," performed by Masaharu Fukuyama with lyrics by Koshi Inaba, lead singer of the legendary rock band B'z.

Hiromi Minami is a blind FBI agent known as the "Last Man," the ultimate ace of the bureau. Partnered with the skilled Detective Shintaro Godo of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department’s First Investigation Division, the invincible duo heads to Hokkaido for a new mission. In the frozen north, Minami unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Nagisa. A world-class genius engineer, Nagisa is being hunted across borders by a mysterious organization for possessing technology that could change the world. To protect his first love and uncover the truth, Minami and Godo join forces with a joint US-Japan investigation team comprising the MPD, newly dispatched FBI agents, the CIA, and the Hokkaido police.

tmdb_overview: 「人可生如蟻而美如神」：一班裁製亮麗戲服的中年裁縫慨嘆自己生如蟻，一名奧斯卡導演拍出她們美如神的生命。導演邀請了 18 位他最熱愛、且在義大利影壇極具分量的女演員，重塑一家高級裁縫工作室色彩斑斕、五味雜陳的過往，追憶70年代一班堅毅溫柔的女裁縫的故事。 一群日常女子拋開小我、互相照顧，照亮平凡生活中超越自我的不平凡，展現她們的獨立、愛慾、掙扎和力量。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.

synopsis: A24全新力作，還原70年代廚房的火爆、高壓與純粹 19歲的東尼（多明尼克塞薩 飾）一心嚮往成為作家，在1975年夏天，為了初戀南西（艾蜜莉雅瓊斯 飾）踏入美國鱈魚角普洛文斯敦一間濱海餐廳的廚房打工洗碗。在餐廳老闆「主廚」（安東尼奧班德拉斯 飾）嚴厲卻真誠的調教下，對料理一竅不通的東尼，逐漸蛻變成對美食充滿狂熱的年輕廚師；而闖蕩江湖的夥伴沙爾（李奧伍道爾 飾）則帶著他一頭栽進酒精、菸草與放縱交織的世界。 在這個瘋狂而炙熱的夏天，東尼第一次嚐到了未來的滋味——那些關於愛、背叛、友情與自我認同的碰撞，讓他第一次明白自己想要成為什麼樣的人。這份熾熱的初心，正是日後撼動全球美食界傳奇名廚的最初起點。

synopsis: 27歲腐女由嘉里（杉咲花 飾）多年來把所有熱情都用在追動漫、同人文上，卻始終無法喜歡真正的自己。因擔心自己孤老終生而開始相親。一次聯誼慘敗後，爛醉的她在歌舞伎町被厭世女公關「萊」（南琴奈 飾）出手相救，兩人就此展開同居生活。在萊的帶領下，由嘉里看見了全新的世界。她陸續認識王牌牛郎朝日（板垣李光人 飾）、高冷的毒舌女作家有希（蒼井優 飾），以及酒吧老闆阿新哥（澀谷清彥 飾），與眾人一起在五光十色的歌舞伎町縱情大笑的日子，讓由嘉里找到了久違的歸屬感。然而，每當看著老將「死亡」掛在嘴邊的萊，由嘉里總是無比擔心，於是她決定要不顧一切幫助萊重拾活下去的勇氣。一場關於愛、陪伴與生命抉擇的考驗隨之展開。 A human drama set in Shinjuku's Kabukicho district, depicting a world shaped by new encounters. Directed by Matsui Daigo, who is known for films such as Remain in Twilight and Just Remembering. Yukari (Sugisaki Hana) adores the manga "Meat Is Mine", but she can't bring herself to like herself. Watching her friends leave one after another due to marriage, childbirth, and other life events, she feels anxiety and impatience about continuing to live this way. One day, while passed out drunk in Kabukicho, she is rescued by Rai (Minami Kotona), a hostess harboring suicidal thoughts.

tmdb_overview: 身為動漫狂粉的單身女，因擔心自己孤老終生而開始相親。一次聯誼慘敗後，爛醉的他在歌舞伎町被厭世美女公關出手相救，兩人就此展開同居生活。正當兩人情誼逐漸超越友達以上，迎來的卻是一場不告而別。
tmdb_overview_en: Yukari, a 27-year old fujoshi fangirl who loves the popular yakiniku-themed pretty boy anime "Meat is Mine", ends up meeting Rai, a pretty but enigmatic bar hostess. As they become friends and roommates in Kabukicho, Yukari starts to get concerned about how Rai doesn't take care of herself and keeps talking about death. Yukari wants to make Rai less suicidal by finding her ex-boyfriend, who she suspects Rai still isn't over.  At the same time Yukari attempts to date a decent guy, pressured by her mother and thinking that love might be the answer to set her life straight. Nevertheless, she ends up spending a lot of time with Rai's friend Asahi, a cheery and friendly (but married) host club boy.  Based on the novel by Hitomi Kanehara.

synopsis: 五位動畫導演以《易經》五卦為引，融合台灣文化，幻化孕育出五個風格與題材各異的獨立故事篇章，交織傳統與未來、信仰與真情、科幻與現實的內爆奇點。在動畫虛空中，漂流宇宙的太空冒險、香燈勇者的遶境列車、肉身超脫的電子穿越、世界末日冷酷異境的青春浪漫，在虛實交錯之間一一絢麗具現。
synopsis_en: Drawing inspiration from five hexagrams of the I Ching, five animation directors fuse Taiwanese culture into five independent chapters, each distinct in style and theme. These stories interweave tradition and the future, faith and raw emotion, creating a singularity where science fiction meets reality. Within the boundless void of animation, a space adventure drifting through the cosmos, a pilgrimage train for "Incense Lamp Warriors," a digital transcendence of the physical form, and a youthful romance set in a cold, post-apocalyptic wasteland vividly come to life at the intersection of the virtual and the real.

synopsis: 改編自希臘作家荷馬（Homer）的同名史詩作品，使用全新的IMAX技術在世界各地取景拍攝， 影片講述奧德修斯在特洛伊戰爭後歷經艱險返鄉，途中遭遇獨眼巨人、女妖與女巫，最終與妻子重逢的傳奇旅程。 電影預告 其他熱映 now showing
tmdb_overview: 改編自荷馬同名史詩。奧德修斯在特洛伊戰爭後歷經艱險返鄉。
tmdb_overview_en: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

movie_title: 原鄉人數位修復客語版
synopsis: 作家鍾理和愛上同姓的鍾平妹，遭家人反對。兩人私奔至瀋陽，期盼在原鄉找到新生活。抗日戰爭結束後，鍾氏一家返回臺灣。歸隱美濃的鍾理和在教書與寫作之間積勞成疾，幸得平妹支持與照顧，才能徹夜未眠握筆在稿紙上築夢。本片主題曲由鄧麗君演唱，更貼近大眾。
source_language_note: 語言 客語 字幕 中、英文
synopsis_en: Writer Zhong Li-he falls in love with Zhong Ping-mei, but because they share the same surname, their relationship faces fierce opposition from their families. The two elope to Shenyang, hoping to build a new life in their ancestral homeland. After the Second Sino-Japanese War ends, the Zhong family returns to Taiwan. Settling into a quiet life in Meinong, Zhong Li-he falls ill from the physical toll of balancing teaching and writing. It is only through Ping-mei’s unwavering support and care that he is able to spend his sleepless nights pursuing his literary dreams on manuscript paper. The film’s theme song, performed by Teresa Teng, further resonates with the hearts of the public.

synopsis: 麥特和阿傑是一對懷抱音樂夢的超級死黨，一搭一唱組成超脫樂團（和那個傳奇樂團Nirvana無關）。兩人為了登上夢寐以求的舞台，想盡各種荒唐計畫，甚至爬上國家電視塔、跳傘空降巨蛋。十七年歲月過去，阿傑不免萌生「單飛比較紅」的念頭，某天麥特異想天開的時光機計劃竟弄假成真，帶他們穿越回2008年... 滿嘴幹話的落漆魯蛇，是否將迎來憨人出頭天的時刻？他們又該如何解決這次危機……。

tmdb_overview: 「超拖」樂團雙人組有夠會拖，兩個懷著成名夢的好友，為了登上表演舞台，每天在破公寓談鋼琴練肖話，還找紀錄片團隊貼身側拍。只是十七年過去，少年變大叔，卻連場地預約電話都還沒打。他們以為只要幹場大事，例如跳下電視塔，成為話題，自然會被注意到。當計劃再度挫屎，習慣言聽計從的那個開始意識到，多年搭檔可能才是拖垮人生的雷包，於是打算拆夥落跑。誰知竟把箱型車開成時光機，陰錯陽差將所有人帶回十七年前的那一天！
tmdb_overview_en: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008.

synopsis: | 普 東京國際影展開幕片 香港亞洲電影節 聖賽巴斯提安國際影展 多部純子與女子登山隊成員們奔波募款，為的是那一場聖母峰的遠征之夢。即便步入婚姻、成家育兒，她也未曾放下對大山的執著，這份堅毅使她成為無數女性眼中的希望之光。1975年，女子登山隊正式挑戰世界之巔。路途中遭遇雪崩重創，純子最終成為唯一一名邁向終點的登山者。她成為全球首位登頂聖母峰的女性，這項壯舉讓全世界為之震驚。然而，聚光燈帶來的名望卻成為一把雙面刃。鎂光燈過度聚焦於純子一人，導致她與隊友間產生難以彌補的隔閡。2010年，純子被確診為腹膜癌末期。面對生死關頭，她依然保持豁達，依舊與老友悅子在星空下共度露營時光。對她而言，抗癌就像是人生的另一場攀登，她決定燃燒餘生，向更高的人心巔峰挑戰。即便生活充滿挑戰，純子始終用笑容溫暖身邊的人。在作為登山家、母親與妻子的多重身分中，純子在生命的最後一刻，在那座心靈的巔峰之上，究竟看見了什麼樣的風景？ Drama that reunites director Sakamoto Junji and actress Yoshinaga Sayuri for the first time since A Chorus of Angels 13 years ago. Portrays a heroine inspired by Tabei Junko, the first woman to successfully scale Mount Everest, and her family. In 1975, Tabe Junko conquered the world's highest summit. However, that incredible achievement not only pointed the spotlight at her friends and family, but also cast a deep shadow. In her later years, Junko (Yoshinaga) was diagnosed with a terminal illness, but she continued to full-heartedly embrace the challenge of mountain climbing.

tmdb_overview_en: In 1975, a woman reached the summit of Mount Everest: Junko, the first woman in history to reach the world's highest peak. Junko's unforgettable feat stunned the world, bringing her into the spotlight but casting a huge shadow over her friends and family. Despite being diagnosed with a terminal illness in her final years, Junko continued to challenge the mountains. What was the last thing she saw beyond the summit?

synopsis: 英文發音中文字幕 — 住在巴黎的老鼠 Remy，擁有異於同伴的敏銳味覺，最大的夢想不是偷食物，而是成為一名真正的主廚。一次意外，讓他與毫無料理天分的餐廳學徒 Linguini 相遇，兩人攜手展開一場既荒唐又充滿驚喜的廚房冒險。 —
screen_name: Dream Plaza R樓

tmdb_overview: 高級法國餐廳容得下一隻老鼠嗎？一隻小老鼠想當大廚的夢想，能不能在廚房的殘酷舞台實現？《超人特攻隊》金獎得主布萊德博德再次展現皮克斯動畫魅力！
tmdb_overview_en: Remy, a rat, possesses a palate far more refined than that of his fellow comrades. He aspires to become a chef, one who creates rather than scavenges. When fate leads him beneath one of Paris's finest restaurants, he forms an unusual alliance with a young kitchen worker to pursue his culinary ambitions. As his double life unfolds, Remy must navigate the suspicions of the calculating Head Chef Skinner, the disapproval of Remy’s own colony, and the foreboding presence of renowned food critic Anton Ego, whose judgment can make or break a chef's legacy.

director: 艾莉絲羅爾瓦雀 Alice Rohrwacher
synopsis: 拉札洛是一位單純善良的年輕農民，在與世隔絕的義大利小城內生活著，他和驕縱叛逆的莊園少爺坦奎迪，從雇傭關係意外結為好友。某天，坦奎迪自導自演了一齣無聊的綁架鬧劇，沒料到卻在這鬧劇中衍生出另一場意外，讓拉札洛穿越時空到多年以後，在人事已非的狀況下，他要如何面對這毫無所知的新世界呢？ 義大利名導艾莉絲羅爾瓦雀魔幻寫實力作，榮獲坎城影展最佳劇本獎。以純樸的義大利鄉村做為背景的寓言故事，透過魔幻寫實手法，淬煉出純真與黑暗、善良與貪婪，將現代都市化的悲歌，昇華成無法言喻而發人深省的古老傳說。
tmdb_overview: 故事描述拉扎洛是一位內心單純的年輕農民在一個與世隔絕的義大利小城內生活，與個性驕縱的莊園少爺坦奎迪從雇傭關係意外結為好友。某天，坦奎迪自導自演了一場無聊的綁架鬧劇，沒料到卻在這鬧劇中衍生出另一場意外，讓拉扎洛穿越時空到多年以後，他要如何面對毫無所知的新世界呢？
tmdb_overview_en: Purehearted teen Lazzaro is content living as a sharecropper in rural Italy, but an unlikely friendship with the marquise’s son will change his world.

synopsis: ★獲得2025 台北金馬影展 NETPAC 奈派克獎、2025 義大利怪獸奇幻影展 最佳影片、2025 加拿大蒙特婁新影展 觀眾票選獎、2026
tmdb_overview: 地獄級恐怖情人「禍禍女」情場肆虐。那些年我們都追不到的男孩、一場慘烈的單戀，讓兇惡怨靈感情債留人間。當不了你眼中的西施，就挖空雙眼讓你成為死屍！美術學校男大生阿宏慘遭毒手，但純愛戰士早苗就算他死了都要愛。禍禍女隨機愛人，少男人夫一個也不放過，讓癡心絕對的早苗決意挖出禍禍女的真面目。「愛你至死不渝」鬥法「愛到卡慘死」，通通愛你去死啦愛！
tmdb_overview_en: The revenge story of a woman whose partner is murdered by a ghost, and who will soon discover the true identity of the one she must avenge.

synopsis: ★ 橫掃國際影展好評，最動人的都會愛情電影，溫哥華影展、高雄電影節、紐約亞洲電影節聯袂推薦 ★ 金鐘獎實力派演員陳妤、侯彥西攜手演繹最真實之青春遺憾，《德布西森林》導演郭承衢睽違多年返臺最新力作 臺北某夜，白玫和丈夫道別後，漫步西區街頭，無意間遇到了多年失聯的傑克。陌生卻熟悉的交談間，曖昧又帶點疏離。等到阿信的出現，這過去三名曾經為了演員夢形影不離，且在這城市一起打拼的年輕人，重新聚在一起了。然而，這六年來的失聯，是因為他們的友誼不堪一擊，還是繽紛閃爍的城市足以沖刷一切？他們該如何在這一夜重逢，搭夥意外加入的毛毛，瞭解未曾道出的秘密，以及留在這裡或離開這裡的理由？
tmdb_overview: 臺北某夜，白玫和丈夫道別後，漫步西區街頭，無意間遇到了多年失聯的傑克。陌生卻熟悉的交談間，曖昧又帶點疏離。等到阿信的出現，這過去三名曾經為了演員夢形影不離，且在這城市一起打拼的年輕人，重新聚在一起了。然而，這六年來的失聯，是因為他們的友誼不堪一擊，還是繽紛閃爍的城市足以沖刷一切？他們該如何在這一夜重逢，搭夥意外加入的毛毛，瞭解未曾道出的秘密，以及留在這裡或離開這裡的理由？
tmdb_overview_en: Blanche, Jake, and Axin went their separate ways six years ago, after sharing a close friendship and a dream of becoming actors. Since then, they've had no contact. What happened? Fate reunites them tonight in the heart of Taipei, but they only have a few hours to uncover the secrets hidden in each other’s hearts.

cinema_name: 國家電影及視聽文化中心
director: 瓦迪瑪約翰森 Valdimar JÓHANNSSON
country: 冰島 Iceland、瑞典 Sweden、波蘭 Poland
synopsis: 2021 坎城影展一種注目原創獎 Prize of Originality for Un Certain Regard, Cannes FF 2021 西班牙錫切斯奇幻影展最佳電影、最佳女主角 Best Film & Best Actress, Sitges International Fantastic FF 冰島一處遺世獨立、宛如時間靜止的迷霧深谷中，隱居的喪子夫婦在自家羊圈裡，迎來了一個打破自然法則的神祕異種誕生。出於對痛失摯愛的執念，他們選擇矇蔽雙眼，將這個半人半羊的畸形混血視如己出，溺愛地豢養在溫馨的屋簷下，卻渾然不知屋外的荒野深處，正醞釀著大自然無聲而暴烈的怒火。 一部風格冷冽、氛圍怪誕的現代民俗寓言，並精準地模糊了文明與原始的界線。全片透過北歐壯麗卻寂靜得令人窒息的地景，喚起了觀眾對大自然的崇敬與畏懼，當人類妄想強行僭越自然、佔有不屬於自己的造物時，那股不可違逆的原始力量，終將索回代價。 In the isolated, mist-shrouded valleys of Iceland, a childless farming couple discovers a mysterious newborn in their barn—a hybrid defying the laws of nature. Choosing love over logic, they raise the creature as their own, blissfully ignoring the silent wrath brewing in the wilderness. An eerie, atmospheric folktale that blurs the boundary between human and beast,
tags: 坎城影展一種注目原創獎
source_language_note: 發音： 冰島語 字幕： 中字 ▲ ▲ 影片非英語發音且無英文字幕 Non-English language film without English subtitles.
screen_name: 國家電影及視聽文化中心-大影格
tmdb_overview: 一對冰島夫妻瑪莉亞和英格瓦，跟他們的羊群住在一個美麗但偏遠的農場，過著離群索居的平凡生活。某日，他們在農場裡發現一個神祕的新生兒，經過一番掙扎後，他們決定把她當成自己的孩子撫養長大。起初，這個決定為他們帶來前所未有的幸福生活，最終卻引領他們走向毀滅的命運……
tmdb_overview_en: An Icelandic couple live with their herd of sheep on a beautiful but remote farm. When they discover a mysterious newborn on their land, they decide to keep it and raise it as their own. This unexpected development and the prospects of a new family brings them much joy before ultimately destroying them.

synopsis: | 護 電影還能這樣拍？ 下北澤，陷入創作地獄的劇團作家圓香來到Tollywood電影院，打算觀賞一部描述樂團團員意外捲入黑幫風波的電影【三軒茶屋大逃脫】。 鄰鎮三軒茶屋的樂團成員和真則來到Tollywood，觀賞的是描述一個搞劇團的女孩捲進一場星際風波的電影【下北澤大逃亡】。對圓香而言，和真就是「電影」；對和真而言，圓香才是「電影」。當和真唸出手上傳單的劇情，精準預料了劇團成員背著圓香，打算進行密謀，兩人開始透過「劇透」與「暴雷」，一邊透過銀幕交談，一邊為了拯救各自即將面臨解散的樂團與劇團而奔走。但天馬行空的劇情發展，還有亂入的「茶澤抵抗軍」，似乎已經超乎了兩人最大的想像……。
tmdb_overview: 陷入創作地獄的舞台劇作家，打算暫離現況去隔壁看個電影喘口氣，當她走進空無一人的影廳，銀幕上的場景怎麼這麼熟悉？畫面中那個因為演唱會票房不佳而與團員吵架的團長，怎麼也坐在一模一樣的影廳內不發一語？觀眾跟角色像是大眼瞪小眼，「這到底是什麼爛片」才剛說出口，銀幕上的他竟回應了……？
tmdb_overview_en: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

synopsis: ★A24全新力作，還原70年代廚房的火爆、高壓與純粹 ★麥特強森狂放執導，以不綁安全帶的手法直擊職人靈魂 ★安東尼奧班德拉斯攜手話題新星多明尼克塞薩，演繹亦師亦父的靈魂羈絆 ★一個夏天、一間廚房、一群瘋子——「在最糟糕的環境中，找到一生熱愛」的熱血成長故事 ★取材自傳奇名廚
tmdb_overview: 19歲的東尼一心嚮往成為作家，在1975年夏天，為了初戀南西踏入美國鱈魚角普洛文斯敦一間濱海餐廳的廚房打工洗碗。在餐廳老闆「主廚」嚴厲卻真誠的調教下，對料理一竅不通的東尼，逐漸蛻變成對美食充滿狂熱的年輕廚師；而闖蕩江湖的夥伴沙爾則帶著他一頭栽進酒精、菸草與放縱交織的世界。在這個瘋狂而炙熱的夏天，東尼第一次嚐到了未來的滋味——那些關於愛、背叛、友情與自我認同的碰撞，讓他第一次明白自己想要成為什麼樣的人。這份熾熱的初心，正是日後撼動全球美食界傳奇名廚的最初起點。
tmdb_overview_en: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

synopsis: ★ 義大利奧斯卡｜榮獲 觀眾大衛獎 最高殊榮 ★
tmdb_overview: 「人可生如蟻而美如神」：一班裁製亮麗戲服的中年裁縫慨嘆自己生如蟻，一名奧斯卡導演拍出她們美如神的生命。導演邀請了 18 位他最熱愛、且在義大利影壇極具分量的女演員，重塑一家高級裁縫工作室色彩斑斕、五味雜陳的過往，追憶70年代一班堅毅溫柔的女裁縫的故事。 一群日常女子拋開小我、互相照顧，照亮平凡生活中超越自我的不平凡，展現她們的獨立、愛慾、掙扎和力量。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.

synopsis: 淺野一二O 經典漫畫作品改編 芽衣子（宮崎葵 飾）與種田（高良健吾 飾）在大學因輕音社而相識，畢業後便展開了同居生活。芽衣子雖然順利成為上班族，卻對千篇一律的工作感到厭倦，對人生更是充滿迷惘。而懷抱音樂夢的種田則維持著一邊在雜誌社打工，一邊與好友共組名為「ROTTI」的樂團。眼看鼓手不得不繼承家業，平日顧著那間小小的藥房，貝斯手則是不想畢業，成了名副其實的六年級生，雖然整個樂團前途渺茫卻始終維持著每週團練。一場突如其來的變故，使得芽衣子決定踏上一條艱辛的道路。
tmdb_overview: 故事描述一起於大學畢業後的情侶：芽衣子和種田之間面對生活、興趣、未來、內心的困惑和煩惱。
tmdb_overview_en: Meiko and Taneda are a couple graduated from university two years ago. Unhappy with their lives, Meiko quits her job and encourages Taneda to have his band become professional.

synopsis: — 在洛杉磯這座充滿夢想的城市，懷抱演員夢的 Mia，遇見一心想守護爵士樂的鋼琴手 Sebastian。兩個在現實中跌跌撞撞的人，因為彼此的相遇，重新相信夢想，也重新相信愛情... —
screen_name: Dream Plaza R樓
tmdb_overview: 在洛杉磯這座充滿可能性的大城市裡，寂寥的小演員蜜亞（艾瑪史東 飾）懷抱著明星夢，一邊端著茶水，一邊到處試鏡；落魄的爵士鋼琴家賽巴斯汀（雷恩葛斯林 飾），在昏黃的酒吧靠演奏鋼琴維生，勉強餬口。同樣追求夢想的兩人在這座城市裡遇見彼此，陷入情網，相互慰藉扶持，一起追求畢生夢想。但在逐漸達成夢想的同時，兩人的情感也面臨抉擇和考驗，究竟他們努力成就的夢想，會成為相愛的阻力還是助力？在夢想與愛情之間，他們該如何選擇？
tmdb_overview_en: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

synopsis: 《世界上最爛的人》導演尤沃金提爾，一鳴驚人首部作品重返大銀幕 伊利和菲利普這對好友都夢想成為作家，就在他們相約寄出作品初稿後，兩人的際遇卻截然不同：菲利普憑著出眾才氣，瞬間在挪威藝文圈爆紅，甚至談起新戀情，不料這番突如其來的轉變卻讓他莫名陷入憂鬱深淵；伊利雖遭出版社婉拒，反而激勵了他繼續朝著夢想前進。半年過去，菲利普雖已痊癒，戀情卻也岌岌可危，渴望再一次擁抱愛情的他，還有重新來過的可能嗎？而立志要在文壇發光發熱的伊利，最終能如願成為一名作家嗎？
tmdb_overview: 伊利和菲利普這對死黨都懷著作家夢，他們相約寄出第一部作品後，迎來了截然不同的際遇。菲利普憑著過人才氣在文壇迅速竄紅，卻又瞬間陷入憂鬱；伊利雖然出師不利，但他仍不放棄地持續努力。半年後，菲利普的狀況改善許多，伊利的寫作技巧也突飛猛進，但兩人的未來會就此一帆風順嗎？
tmdb_overview_en: Fueled by literary aspirations and youthful exuberance, two competitive friends endure the pangs of love, depression, and burgeoning careers.

synopsis: ◎2026奧斯卡最佳國際電影15強 ◎2025坎城影展「一種注目」競賽片 ◎寶萊塢銀幕獎最佳影片等15項大獎提名 ◎印度年度最佳導演、最佳女主角雙料大獎 ◎印度影評人選擇獎最佳影片、最佳導演、最佳男主角、最佳女配角4項大獎
tmdb_overview: 在印度北部一個小村莊裡，兩位兒時好友渴望成為警察，以此重拾長期被剝奪的尊嚴。然而，隨著他們一步步接近夢想，日益增長的絕望威脅著他們彼此之間的紐帶。
tmdb_overview_en: Two childhood friends from a small North Indian village chase a police job that promises them the dignity they’ve long been denied. But as they inch closer to their dream, mounting desperation threatens the bond that holds them together.

synopsis: | 普 東京國際影展開幕片 香港亞洲電影節 聖賽巴斯提安國際影展 多部純子與女子登山隊成員們奔波募款，為的是那一場聖母峰的遠征之夢。即便步入婚姻、成家育兒，她也未曾放下對大山的執著，這份堅毅使她成為無數女性眼中的希望之光。1975年，女子登山隊正式挑戰世界之巔。路途中遭遇雪崩重創，純子最終成為唯一一名邁向終點的登山者。她成為全球首位登頂聖母峰的女性，這項壯舉讓全世界為之震驚。然而，聚光燈帶來的名望卻成為一把雙面刃。鎂光燈過度聚焦於純子一人，導致她與隊友間產生難以彌補的隔閡。2010年，純子被確診為腹膜癌末期。面對生死關頭，她依然保持豁達，依舊與老友悅子在星空下共度露營時光。對她而言，抗癌就像是人生的另一場攀登，她決定燃燒餘生，向更高的人心巔峰挑戰。即便生活充滿挑戰，純子始終用笑容溫暖身邊的人。在作為登山家、母親與妻子的多重身分中，純子在生命的最後一刻，在那座心靈的巔峰之上，究竟看見了什麼樣的風景？ Drama that reunites director Sakamoto Junji and actress Yoshinaga Sayuri for the first time since A Chorus of Angels 13 years ago. Portrays a heroine inspired by Tabei Junko, the first woman to successfully scale Mount Everest, and her family. In 1975, Tabe Junko conquered the world's highest summit. However, that incredible achievement not only pointed the spotlight at her friends and family, but also cast a deep shadow. In her later years, Junko (Yoshinaga) was diagnosed with a terminal illness, but she continued to full-heartedly embrace the challenge of mountain climbing.

Junko's unforgettable feat stunned the world, bringing her into the spotlight but casting a huge shadow over her friends and family. Despite being diagnosed with a terminal illness in her final years, Junko continued to challenge the mountains. What was the last thing she saw beyond the summit?

synopsis: 1945年8月15日，日本透過「玉音放送」宣布無條件接受波茲坦宣言，第二次世界大戰正式結束。對當時生活在福爾摩沙的台灣人民來說，這一天也終結了他們原本認知的世界。日本對台灣的殖民統治因戰敗而崩解，而當了五十年「日本人」的台灣島民一夜之間成了「中國人」，在中日交戰夾縫下的台灣，一夕之間從戰敗國成為戰勝國。 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常：在前線奮戰的軍屬、造飛機的少年工、戰場看護助手、想成為文化教育者的師範生，以及無數因為戰爭打亂生活的尋常百姓。本片運用最先進的上色技術，將黑白的歷史資料片轉為彩色，重現栩栩如生的真實感；經過精心的音效設計，復原默片影像完整的音場；透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。 《終戰那一天》不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。 電影預告 其他熱映
tmdb_overview: 《終戰那一天》挖掘了失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。
synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

synopsis_en: Drawing inspiration from five hexagrams of the I Ching, five animation directors fuse Taiwanese culture into five independent chapters, each distinct in style and theme. These stories interweave tradition and the future, faith and raw emotion, creating a singularity where science fiction meets reality. Within the boundless void of animation, a space adventure drifting through the cosmos, a pilgrimage train for "Incense Lamp Warriors," a digital transcendence of the physical form, and a youthful romance set in a cold, post-apocalyptic wasteland vividly come to life at the intersection of the virtual and the real.

synopsis_en:
Japan Academy Film Prize winner Rie Miyazawa and popular South Korean actor Rowoon join the original TV series cast—including Ren Nagase, Mio Imada, and Yo Yoshida—for a powerful return to the screen. The film features the theme song "Jupiter," performed by Masaharu Fukuyama with lyrics by Koshi Inaba, lead singer of the legendary rock band B'z.

Hiromi Minami is a blind FBI agent known as the "Last Man," the ultimate ace of the bureau. Partnered with the skilled Detective Shintaro Godo of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department’s First Investigation Division, the invincible duo heads to Hokkaido for a new mission. In the frozen north, Minami unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Nagisa. A world-class genius engineer, Nagisa is being hunted across borders by a mysterious organization for possessing technology that could change the world. To protect his first love and uncover the truth, Minami and Godo join forces with a joint US-Japan investigation team comprising the MPD, newly dispatched FBI agents, the CIA, and the Hokkaido police.

synopsis: 27歲腐女由嘉里（杉咲花 飾）多年來把所有熱情都用在追動漫、同人文上，卻始終無法喜歡真正的自己。因擔心自己孤老終生而開始相親。一次聯誼慘敗後，爛醉的她在歌舞伎町被厭世女公關「萊」（南琴奈 飾）出手相救，兩人就此展開同居生活。在萊的帶領下，由嘉里看見了全新的世界。她陸續認識王牌牛郎朝日（板垣李光人 飾）、高冷的毒舌女作家有希（蒼井優 飾），以及酒吧老闆阿新哥（澀谷清彥 飾），與眾人一起在五光十色的歌舞伎町縱情大笑的日子，讓由嘉里找到了久違的歸屬感。然而，每當看著老將「死亡」掛在嘴邊的萊，由嘉里總是無比擔心，於是她決定要不顧一切幫助萊重拾活下去的勇氣。一場關於愛、陪伴與生命抉擇的考驗隨之展開。 A human drama set in Shinjuku's Kabukicho district, depicting a world shaped by new encounters. Directed by Matsui Daigo, who is known for films such as Remain in Twilight and Just Remembering. Yukari (Sugisaki Hana) adores the manga "Meat Is Mine", but she can't bring herself to like herself. Watching her friends leave one after another due to marriage, childbirth, and other life events, she feels anxiety and impatience about continuing to live this way. One day, while passed out drunk in Kabukicho, she is rescued by Rai (Minami Kotona), a hostess harboring suicidal thoughts.

tmdb_overview_en: Yukari, a 27-year old fujoshi fangirl who loves the popular yakiniku-themed pretty boy anime "Meat is Mine", ends up meeting Rai, a pretty but enigmatic bar hostess. As they become friends and roommates in Kabukicho, Yukari starts to get concerned about how Rai doesn't take care of herself and keeps talking about death. synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

tmdb_overview: 在印度北部一個小村莊裡，兩位兒時好友渴望成為警察，以此重拾長期被剝奪的尊嚴。然而，隨著他們一步步接近夢想，日益增長的絕望威脅著他們彼此之間的紐帶。
tmdb_overview_en: Two childhood friends from a small North Indian village chase a police job that promises them the dignity they’ve long been denied. But as they inch closer to their dream, mounting desperation threatens the bond that holds them together.

synopsis: ★A24全新力作，還原70年代廚房的火爆、高壓與純粹 ★麥特強森狂放執導，以不綁安全帶的手法直擊職人靈魂 ★安東尼奧班德拉斯攜手話題新星多明尼克塞薩，演繹亦師亦父的靈魂羈絆 ★一個夏天、一間廚房、一群瘋子——「在最糟糕的環境中，找到一生熱愛」的熱血成長故事 ★取材自傳奇名廚
tmdb_overview: 19歲的東尼一心嚮往成為作家，在1975年夏天，為了初戀南西踏入美國鱈魚角普洛文斯敦一間濱海餐廳的廚房打工洗碗。在餐廳老闆「主廚」嚴厲卻真誠的調教下，對料理一竅不通的東尼，逐漸蛻變成對美食充滿狂熱的年輕廚師；而闖蕩江湖的夥伴沙爾則帶著他一頭栽進酒精、菸草與放縱交織的世界。在這個瘋狂而炙熱的夏天，東尼第一次嚐到了未來的滋味——那些關於愛、背叛、友情與自我認同的碰撞，讓他第一次明白自己想要成為什麼樣的人。這份熾熱的初心，正是日後撼動全球美食界傳奇名廚的最初起點。
tmdb_overview_en: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

synopsis: 《世界上最爛的人》導演尤沃金提爾，一鳴驚人首部作品重返大銀幕 伊利和菲利普這對好友都夢想成為作家，就在他們相約寄出作品初稿後，兩人的際遇卻截然不同：菲利普憑著出眾才氣，瞬間在挪威藝文圈爆紅，甚至談起新戀情，不料這番突如其來的轉變卻讓他莫名陷入憂鬱深淵；伊利雖遭出版社婉拒，反而激勵了他繼續朝著夢想前進。半年過去，菲利普雖已痊癒，戀情卻也岌岌可危，渴望再一次擁抱愛情的他，還有重新來過的可能嗎？而立志要在文壇發光發熱的伊利，最終能如願成為一名作家嗎？
tmdb_overview: 伊利和菲利普這對死黨都懷著作家夢，他們相約寄出第一部作品後，迎來了截然不同的際遇。菲利普憑著過人才氣在文壇迅速竄紅，卻又瞬間陷入憂鬱；伊利雖然出師不利，但他仍不放棄地持續努力。半年後，菲利普的狀況改善許多，伊利的寫作技巧也突飛猛進，但兩人的未來會就此一帆風順嗎？
tmdb_overview_en: Fueled by literary aspirations and youthful exuberance, two competitive friends endure the pangs of love, depression, and burgeoning careers.

synopsis: 1945年8月15日，日本透過「玉音放送」宣布無條件接受波茲坦宣言，第二次世界大戰正式結束。對當時生活在福爾摩沙的台灣人民來說，這一天也終結了他們原本認知的世界。日本對台灣的殖民統治因戰敗而崩解，而當了五十年「日本人」的台灣島民一夜之間成了「中國人」，在中日交戰夾縫下的台灣，一夕之間從戰敗國成為戰勝國。 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常：在前線奮戰的軍屬、造飛機的少年工、戰場看護助手、想成為文化教育者的師範生，以及無數因為戰爭打亂生活的尋常百姓。本片運用最先進的上色技術，將黑白的歷史資料片轉為彩色，重現栩栩如生的真實感；經過精心的音效設計，復原默片影像完整的音場；透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。 《終戰那一天》不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。 電影預告 其他熱映

synopsis: 27歲腐女由嘉里（杉咲花 飾）多年來把所有熱情都用在追動漫、同人文上，卻始終無法喜歡真正的自己。因擔心自己孤老終生而開始相親。一次聯誼慘敗後，爛醉的她在歌舞伎町被厭世女公關「萊」（南琴奈 飾）出手相救，兩人就此展開同居生活。在萊的帶領下，由嘉里看見了全新的世界。她陸續認識王牌牛郎朝日（板垣李光人 飾）、高冷的毒舌女作家有希（蒼井優 飾），以及酒吧老闆阿新哥（澀谷清彥 飾），與眾人一起在五光十色的歌舞伎町縱情大笑的日子，讓由嘉里找到了久違的歸屬感。然而，每當看著老將「死亡」掛在嘴邊的萊，由嘉里總是無比擔心，於是她決定要不顧一切幫助萊重拾活下去的勇氣。一場關於愛、陪伴與生命抉擇的考驗隨之展開。 A human drama set in Shinjuku's Kabukicho district, depicting a world shaped by new encounters. Directed by Matsui Daigo, who is known for films such as Remain in Twilight and Just Remembering. Yukari (Sugisaki Hana) adores the manga "Meat Is Mine", but she can't bring herself to like herself. Watching her friends leave one after another due to marriage, childbirth, and other life events, she feels anxiety and impatience about continuing to live this way. synopsis_en:
Japan Academy Film Prize winner Rie Miyazawa and popular South Korean actor Rowoon join the original TV series cast—including Ren Nagase, Mio Imada, and Yo Yoshida—for a powerful return to the screen. The film features the theme song "Jupiter," performed by Masaharu Fukuyama with lyrics by Koshi Inaba, lead singer of the legendary rock band B'z.

Hiromi Minami is a blind FBI agent known as the "Last Man," the ultimate ace of the bureau. Partnered with the skilled Detective Shintaro Godo of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department’s First Investigation Division, the invincible duo heads to Hokkaido for a new mission. In the frozen north, Minami unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Nagisa. A world-class genius engineer, Nagisa is being hunted across borders by a mysterious organization for possessing technology that could change the world. To protect his first love and uncover the truth, Minami and Godo join forces with a joint US-Japan investigation team comprising the MPD, newly dispatched FBI agents, the CIA, and the Hokkaido police.

synopsis: 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常，透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。

synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

Directed by Matsui Daigo, who is known for films such as Remain in Twilight and Just Remembering. Yukari (Sugisaki Hana) adores the manga "Meat Is Mine", but she can't bring herself to like herself. Watching her friends leave one after another due to marriage, childbirth, and other life events, she feels anxiety and impatience about continuing to live this way. One day, while passed out drunk in Kabukicho, she is rescued by Rai (Minami Kotona), a hostess harboring suicidal thoughts.

synopsis: A24全新力作，還原70年代廚房的火爆、高壓與純粹 19歲的東尼（多明尼克塞薩 飾）一心嚮往成為作家，在1975年夏天，為了初戀南西（艾蜜莉雅瓊斯 飾）踏入美國鱈魚角普洛文斯敦一間濱海餐廳的廚房打工洗碗。在餐廳老闆「主廚」（安東尼奧班德拉斯 飾）嚴厲卻真誠的調教下，對料理一竅不通的東尼，逐漸蛻變成對美食充滿狂熱的年輕廚師；而闖蕩江湖的夥伴沙爾（李奧伍道爾 飾）則帶著他一頭栽進酒精、菸草與放縱交織的世界。 在這個瘋狂而炙熱的夏天，東尼第一次嚐到了未來的滋味——那些關於愛、背叛、友情與自我認同的碰撞，讓他第一次明白自己想要成為什麼樣的人。這份熾熱的初心，正是日後撼動全球美食界傳奇名廚的最初起點。

synopsis: 五位動畫導演以《易經》五卦為引，融合台灣文化，幻化孕育出五個風格與題材各異的獨立故事篇章，交織傳統與未來、信仰與真情、科幻與現實的內爆奇點。在動畫虛空中，漂流宇宙的太空冒險、香燈勇者的遶境列車、肉身超脫的電子穿越、世界末日冷酷異境的青春浪漫，在虛實交錯之間一一絢麗具現。
synopsis_en: Drawing inspiration from five hexagrams of the I Ching, five animation directors fuse Taiwanese culture into five independent chapters, each distinct in style and theme. These stories interweave tradition and the future, faith and raw emotion, creating a singularity where science fiction meets reality. Within the boundless void of animation, a space adventure drifting through the cosmos, a pilgrimage train for "Incense Lamp Warriors," a digital transcendence of the physical form, and a youthful romance set in a cold, post-apocalyptic wasteland vividly come to life at the intersection of the virtual and the real.

synopsis: | 普 東京國際影展開幕片 香港亞洲電影節 聖賽巴斯提安國際影展 多部純子與女子登山隊成員們奔波募款，為的是那一場聖母峰的遠征之夢。即便步入婚姻、成家育兒，她也未曾放下對大山的執著，這份堅毅使她成為無數女性眼中的希望之光。1975年，女子登山隊正式挑戰世界之巔。路途中遭遇雪崩重創，純子最終成為唯一一名邁向終點的登山者。她成為全球首位登頂聖母峰的女性，這項壯舉讓全世界為之震驚。然而，聚光燈帶來的名望卻成為一把雙面刃。鎂光燈過度聚焦於純子一人，導致她與隊友間產生難以彌補的隔閡。2010年，純子被確診為腹膜癌末期。面對生死關頭，她依然保持豁達，依舊與老友悅子在星空下共度露營時光。對她而言，抗癌就像是人生的另一場攀登，她決定燃燒餘生，向更高的人心巔峰挑戰。即便生活充滿挑戰，純子始終用笑容溫暖身邊的人。在作為登山家、母親與妻子的多重身分中，純子在生命的最後一刻，在那座心靈的巔峰之上，究竟看見了什麼樣的風景？ Drama that reunites director Sakamoto Junji and actress Yoshinaga Sayuri for the first time since A Chorus of Angels 13 years ago. Portrays a heroine inspired by Tabei Junko, the first woman to successfully scale Mount Everest, and her family. In 1975, Tabe Junko conquered the world's highest summit. However, that incredible achievement not only pointed the spotlight at her friends and family, but also cast a deep shadow. In her later years, Junko (Yoshinaga) was diagnosed with a terminal illness, but she continued to full-heartedly embrace the challenge of mountain climbing.

tmdb_overview_en: In 1975, a woman reached the summit of Mount Everest: Junko, the first woman in history to reach the world's highest peak. Junko's unforgettable feat stunned the world, bringing her into the spotlight but casting a huge shadow over her friends and family. Despite being diagnosed with a terminal illness in her final years, Junko continued to challenge the mountains. What was the last thing she saw beyond the summit?

synopsis: 1945年8月15日，日本透過「玉音放送」宣布無條件接受波茲坦宣言，第二次世界大戰正式結束。對當時生活在福爾摩沙的台灣人民來說，這一天也終結了他們原本認知的世界。日本對台灣的殖民統治因戰敗而崩解，而當了五十年「日本人」的台灣島民一夜之間成了「中國人」，在中日交戰夾縫下的台灣，一夕之間從戰敗國成為戰勝國。 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常：在前線奮戰的軍屬、造飛機的少年工、戰場看護助手、想成為文化教育者的師範生，以及無數因為戰爭打亂生活的尋常百姓。本片運用最先進的上色技術，將黑白的歷史資料片轉為彩色，重現栩栩如生的真實感；經過精心的音效設計，復原默片影像完整的音場；透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。 《終戰那一天》不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。 電影預告 其他熱映

synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

synopsis: 27歲腐女由嘉里（杉咲花 飾）多年來把所有熱情都用在追動漫、同人文上，卻始終無法喜歡真正的自己。因擔心自己孤老終生而開始相親。一次聯誼慘敗後，爛醉的她在歌舞伎町被厭世女公關「萊」（南琴奈 飾）出手相救，兩人就此展開同居生活。在萊的帶領下，由嘉里看見了全新的世界。她陸續認識王牌牛郎朝日（板垣李光人 飾）、高冷的毒舌女作家有希（蒼井優 飾），以及酒吧老闆阿新哥（澀谷清彥 飾），與眾人一起在五光十色的歌舞伎町縱情大笑的日子，讓由嘉里找到了久違的歸屬感。然而，每當看著老將「死亡」掛在嘴邊的萊，由嘉里總是無比擔心，於是她決定要不顧一切幫助萊重拾活下去的勇氣。一場關於愛、陪伴與生命抉擇的考驗隨之展開。 A human drama set in Shinjuku's Kabukicho district, depicting a world shaped by new encounters. Directed by Matsui Daigo, who is known for films such as Remain in Twilight and Just Remembering. Yukari (Sugisaki Hana) adores the manga "Meat Is Mine", but she can't bring herself to like herself. Watching her friends leave one after another due to marriage, childbirth, and other life events, she feels anxiety and impatience about continuing to live this way. One day, while passed out drunk in Kabukicho, she is rescued by Rai (Minami Kotona), a hostess harboring suicidal thoughts.

tmdb_overview: 身為動漫狂粉的單身女，因擔心自己孤老終生而開始相親。一次聯誼慘敗後，爛醉的他在歌舞伎町被厭世美女公關出手相救，兩人就此展開同居生活。正當兩人情誼逐漸超越友達以上，迎來的卻是一場不告而別。
tmdb_overview_en: Yukari, a 27-year old fujoshi fangirl who loves the popular yakiniku-themed pretty boy anime "Meat is Mine", ends up meeting Rai, a pretty but enigmatic bar hostess. As they become friends and roommates in Kabukicho, Yukari starts to get concerned about how Rai doesn't take care of herself and keeps talking about death. Yukari wants to make Rai less suicidal by finding her ex-boyfriend, who she suspects Rai still isn't over.  At the same time Yukari attempts to date a decent guy, pressured by her mother and thinking that love might be the answer to set her life straight. Nevertheless, she ends up spending a lot of time with Rai's friend Asahi, a cheery and friendly (but married) host club boy.  Based on the novel by Hitomi Kanehara.
